_description: Default style. One column; centred name and role; 3-column contact header; uppercase section titles over a solid black rule; entries with a dotted grey rule between header and content; optional 2-column block. Montserrat, A4, 2 pages max.
_origin: Measured from a CV made in Google Docs (Skia PDF). Values in PostScript points except colours. They come from pdfinfo, pdffonts, pdftohtml -xml and pixel analysis at 130 dpi, not from eyeballing. Adjusted (not measured) values carry a _note.

fonts._note_bullets: Montserrat has no bullet glyphs; the original drew them with Arial. The CSS falls back to a system font only for the bullet.

sizes._note_name: Measured 19.3 in the original, but pdftohtml rounds sizes to integers and the 700 cut of variable Montserrat is not exactly the static Bold. At 19.3 the name rendered 6% short; 20.5 matches the stroke height measured in pixels (16.0pt).
sizes._note_factsheet: Project fact line ('Stack: ...'). Not in the original; added so the line under a project title reads as secondary.

columns._note_header: Both side columns MUST have the same width or the middle one is not centred on the page. 37/26/37 comes from the widest content of each column over 510.2pt.

block_pattern: Entity (700, sizes.entity)            ...  note on the right (italic, sizes.body)
Position (400, sizes.position)        ...  dates on the right (italic, sizes.body)
